rule.description: A solution entry method absorbed its former sub-method chain into one body: the function re-enters itself recursively, declares default arguments, and switches between its driver phase and its recursive walker phase only by comparing one of those defaulted arguments against a sentinel constant (None/-1/0/...). A clean delegation structure keeps the driver, the walker and the seed state in separate methods, so a function that is at once driver, walker and support layer is the deeply inlined method smell.

checks.description: Detect an entry method that runs the whole absorbed sub-method chain itself: it seeds the shared state, branches on sentinel comparisons of its own defaulted arguments to decide the phase, and re-enters itself to continue the walk.
checks.detected_relation: defaulted-argument sentinel test + direct self-recursion inside one function body
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The three structural facts that the rule tests a defaulted argument against a sentinel constant, that the same function recurses into itself, and that both appear in one body identify a function that merged the driver method, the recursive walker method and the seed state of a former delegation chain into a single scope. Splitting the phases back out into separate well-scoped methods removes exactly this relation, which is the target of the assigned deeply inlined method smell.

matches.evidence: mergeKLists(lists, low=0, high=-1) widens high from the -1 default on the first call, then re-enters itself as self.mergeKLists(lists, low, mid) and self.mergeKLists(lists, mid+1, high); the two-list merge and the stitch loop that used to live in a helper are inlined in the same body.

solveSudoku(board, empty=None) fills empty from the None default on the first call, re-enters itself as self.solveSudoku(board, empty) and again after each tentative assignment; the blank collection loop, the feasibility scan and the backtracking step are inlined in the same body.

partition(s, result=None, path=None, start=0) materializes result and path from the None defaults on the first call, re-enters itself as self.partition(s, result, path, i+1) while growing the current split; the palindrome scan loop that used to live in a helper is inlined in the same body.

numberOfPatterns(m, n, used=None, last=-1, length=0) seeds used from the None default, overrides last with the -1 sentinel per seed call and re-enters itself twice (per candidate length and per walk step); the validity test that used to live in a helper is inlined as an elif chain in the same body.

excluded.reason: The entry method memoizes via a defaulted dictionary argument and recurses into itself, but it never tests a defaulted argument against a sentinel constant: its memoization stays a plain keyword inside the method, so the absorbed-driver signature is absent and the rule does not fire.

The class contains a three-method delegation chain (entry, child walk, node helper), but the chain is iterative and never recursive; the entry never re-enters itself, so it cannot carry the walker phase of the signature and is intentionally outside this rule.
The class contains a three-method delegation chain (entry, cell walk, rank helper), but again iterative rather than recursive: no self-recursion exists to absorb, so the rule does not apply.

excluded.location: python/046_Permutations.py and the other two-method chain classes
excluded.reason: These classes split work between only two methods (entry plus one helper), a chain too shallow for the three-level absorption this rule encodes; they are left for other cases of the smell family.
